newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti up on Bell, Fr Telecom comments.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti up on Bell, Fr Telecom comments.

text.p: Shares in Italy's Olivetti rose sharply after comments from Bell Atlantic and France Telecom concerning their interest in the businesses of the information technology group, dealers said.

France Telecom managing director Michel Bon was reported as saying his company did not rule out buying a stake in Olivetti if this was the only way to become strong in Italian telecoms, but he added there were easier ways such as joining Olivetti's Infostrada fixed-line telecoms joint venture.

In addition, Bell Atlantic's chief Thomas Bartlett said in a newspaper report that he was interested in increasing Bell's stake in Omnitel. Olivetti is the largest shareholder in Omnitel, and Bell recently bought a stake from Olivetti to boost its position in Italy's second mobile phone consortium.
"Certainly, the interest from abroad can only be positive for Olivetti," said one dealer.
At 1012 GMT, shares in Olivetti were up 2.88 percent at 667 lire after hitting a day's high of 677 lire in a slightly firmer Milan stock market.
